description: This file defines a data structure and functions for managing relay configuration related to a shared gateway. It includes a Codable struct for configuration data, an enum with static methods for saving/loading/clearing configuration and event messages using UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the relay configuration from UserDefaults, decoding JSON data into ShareGatewayRelayConfig object.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Encodes ShareGatewayRelayConfig object into JSON data and saves it to UserDefaults.

methods.name: clearConfig
methods.description: Removes the relay configuration from UserDefaults.

methods.name: saveLastEvent
methods.description: Saves a timestamped message as the last event in UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadLastEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the last event message from UserDefaults, returning nil if none exists or if the message is empty.
